name: Seedream 5.0 资产图提示词编译
description: 把 CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD 中的单个人物、场景或道具及其视觉身份合同编译为 Seedream 5.0 专属执行提示词；人物身份由 Pro 参考图链保持，场景和道具由 Lite 生成。
when_to_use: Replica 第 3 步使用火山方舟 Seedream 5.0 Pro 与 Lite 生成真实资产图
when_not_to_use: 需要修改本土化分镜语义

steps.title: 分析资产视觉证据
steps.description: 只读取当前资产的视觉身份合同与实际分镜证据，过滤不可直接绘制的叙事关系。

steps.title: 编译 Seedream 5.0 提示词
steps.description: 为 Pro 人物参考图链或 Lite 场景道具生成具体英文执行提示词。

provider_rules: Return exactly one prompt result for every requested target_entity_id.
Character prompts contain one stable visible identity and never turn relationships or dialogue into additional people.
Character layout and orientation instructions belong to the Runtime; the authored identity prompt must not request a collage, contact sheet or turnaround.
Scene prompts isolate stable spatial identity without adding story characters.
Prop prompts isolate form, scale, material, color and signature details without unrelated people.
Execution prompts are concrete English; review_prompt_zh is Simplified Chinese.
Do not generate ids, media paths, image bytes or video prompts.
completion_criteria: 每个资产都有 Seedream 5.0 专属提示词
人物提示词保持单人物稳定身份
Runtime 尚未执行且未伪造 reference_media
failure_policy: Provider coverage 不完整时整批失败
人物提示词泄漏多面板布局指令时 fail closed
不得回退到通用字符串拼接器
